phase_name: Inventory probe core — enumeration, size, callers, test pairing

objectives.description: Adopt header/usage/--root/--check conventions from assess-repo-health.sh and measure-eager-context.sh
Implement enumeration of non-test .sh files under agent-system/extensions/**

approaches_tried.approach: Pass per-script caller/test-path arrays to jq via --args/$ARGS.positional
approaches_tried.reason: jq's --args requires the filter to be the single positional program argument; interleaving two differently-sized positional lists in one invocation doesn't work. Replaced with a to_json_array() helper that pipes newline-joined values through `jq -R -s -c`.

approaches_tried.approach: Pass the full assembled scripts array to the final jq -n call via --argjson on the command line
approaches_tried.reason: exceeds exec argv size limit ("Argument list too long") at ~193 real scripts with caller-path arrays. Replaced with writing to a mktemp scratch file (outside $ROOT) and reading via --slurpfile.
